title: Grilled Binchotan Skewers with Slovakian Hash
description: A flavorful and healthy meal featuring grilled binchotan skewers served with a crispy Slovakian hash.
instructions: Soak 10 bamboo skewers in water for at least 30 minutes.
Thread 5-6 pieces of binchotan onto each skewer, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with 'by' and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the binchotan is cooked through.
While the skewers are cooking, heat the Slovakian meal in a pan over medium heat.
Add the hash to the pan and cook until crispy, stirring occasionally.
Add the 'kissed' to the hash and stir to combine.
Serve the grilled binchotan skewers with the Slovakian hash.
